source: The locked, previously evaluated stress12 and new_three4 session panels in cohort_session_matched_design.json. Development on both panels. Use single-person sub-04 R4, the already decoded word, its eight support photographs from other folds, and the corresponding own-EEG SDXL JPEG. No new queries, prompts or seeds.
training: Use only the 512 unrelated calibration objects for this participant. Predict a 4 by 4 field of DINOv2-S/14 patch descriptors from within-object posterior EEG differences. Unit normalize each of the 16 by 16 final patch tokens and average 4 by 4 cells. Keep the full 512-pixel composition by resizing to 224 for this descriptor. Fit ridge with standardized EEG and penalty 2 times the fitting row count. Use the existing 416/96 generic object split once to calibrate one nonnegative least-squares residual gain clipped at one, then refit the ridge on all 512.
renderer: Hold the generated image fixed. From its 16 by 16 frozen local descriptor field, learn a smooth bounded displacement of its pixels to match the predicted 4 by 4 patch field. Fit four by four interior displacement knots with fixed zero borders, bilinear interpolation, maximum displacement 0.28 in normalized sampling coordinates, Adam at 0.12 for 32 steps. Minimize mean squared descriptor error multiplied by the channel dimension plus 0.02 times mean squared normalized displacement. Use the same settings and JPEG quality 95 for all arms.
blind_arms: warp to mean of eight visual supports
warp to support mean plus matched EEG residual
same support mean with another query's residual from the frozen same predicted word and fold donor map
positive_control: After writing and hashing all blind outputs for both panels, use exact target photograph patch descriptors for a separate oracle warp. Use only for scoring the editing capacity, never as an inference condition.
primary: Independent of the DINO warp objective, score frozen LAION ViT-H/14 exact original identification among all ten photos of the true object, and report own versus each of neutral, prior and exchanged EEG. The original base generator uses H/14 conditions. Also report mean rank, two-view same-fold assignment, DINOv2 CLS intra10, low-resolution RGB RMSE, spatial luminance correlation, and the fixed first row for each object. Each panel has 120 photographs and one participant. Intervals resample all twelve objects with replacement, 10000 draws, seed 260536.
decision: Promote only if the paired 95% interval for matched minus both neutral and exchanged EEG on ViT-H/14 intra10 excludes zero in the positive direction on both panels. Report all arms even if the ceiling fails. This is a development experiment on reused panels.
